meta.name: Reverse Mountain
meta.description: La Reverse Mountain es la entrada al Grand Line. Lo que le espera a los Sombrero de Paja son corrientes de agua imposibles, una ballena gigante, y dudosa gente con nombres clave.

videos.title: Reverse Mountain
videos.overview: Following a near disaster in the Calm Belt, the Straw Hats take a wild ride up and down a mountain… and are promptly swallowed by a giant whale!

videos.title: Cape Promise
videos.overview: After learning of Laboon the whale's plight, Luffy comes up with a solution befitting his style. As thanks, Crocus reveals that navigating the Grand Line will not be as simple as following a compass or relying on currents and wind.
